description: Cloudflare WAF and Rate Limiting Ruleset for SecureVault

rules.description: Rate limit SIWE nonce generation to 10 requests/min per IP
Rate limit SIWE verification to 10 attempts/min per IP to prevent signature brute forcing
Rate limit encrypted file upload endpoint to 30 requests/min per IP
Block SQLi, XSS, and command injection patterns in request URI and headers
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "<script>" or http.request.uri.query contains "union+select" or http.request.uri.query contains "..%2f" or http.request.uri.query contains "../" or http.request.uri.path contains "../" or http.request.uri.path contains "..%2f")

rules.description: Challenge requests with high threat score or suspicious bot signatures
rules.expression: (cf.threat_score gt 25 or (cf.client.bot and not cf.verified_bot_category in {"Search Engine Crawler"}))

rules.description: Enforce presence of valid Sec-Fetch-Site or Origin header on POST/PUT/DELETE API endpoints
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path matches "^/api/" and http.request.method in {"POST", "PUT", "DELETE"} and not (http.request.headers["sec-fetch-site"][0] in {"same-origin", "same-site"} or http.request.headers["origin"][0] matches "^https?://(localhost|.*\.yourdomain\.com)"))

rules.description: Managed challenge for all /admin requests from unexpected networks
